incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 03/15 18:12 UTC - gpu_queue_depth_high - queue depth > 5k for > 5m. autoscaler failures detected. paging Ash (SRE) and Ravi (Oncall-ML).

Ash (SRE): I'm on it. seeing continuous growth on inference-queue across both eu-west and us-west pools. current queue depth 12,400 and still climbing. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but backoff due to node provisioning errors.

Ravi (Oncall-ML): joining. Do we know if it's a quota/region issue or image boot failures?

Kim (Infra): noticing a pattern: cloud provider returned RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on several create_node calls around 18:07 UTC in us-west-2. max_nodes for gpu-pool is 128 but account quota shows 96 available. Recent burst demand pushed us past soft limits.

Lina (Eng-runtime): runtime reports full KV cache eviction storms when new shards spin up. That plus the node provisioning tear-downs is causing long tail latencies. Also autoscaler retry policy is exponential; multiple failures left requests queued for longer than our 2s target.

Ash (SRE): immediate mitigation plan: 1) Reduce incoming load by enabling routing policy to divert non-critical requests to cpu-fallback; 2) Open temporary small GPU burst pool with existing dedicated capacity (if infra can attach); 3) Lower default batch sizes for hosted endpoints to reduce pressure.

Maya (Support): can we get a customer impact note? Trading desk customers report timeouts on embeddings jobs. I'll draft comms once we know affected regions and duration.

Ravi (Oncall-ML): running a quick command to throttle low-priority routes now: 
```bash
# routing control api
curl -X POST "$ROUTE_API/modify" -d '{"route":"/embed/bulk","policy":"deprioritize","max_qps":5}' 
```
Response: 200 OK. Deprioritizing bulk embed routes.

Ash (SRE): triggering cpu-fallback for eligible models: 
```json
{"route":"/embed/large-batch","fallback":"cpu-small","reason":"gpu queue overflow"}
```
Applied. Expect drop in queue growth in ~30s. :eyes:

Kim (Infra): trying to create nodes in eu-west-1 from spare reserved pool: hit quota at 64/64. Opening quota ticket now (cloud console ticket ID: 544321). For immediate relief, I can attach a pre-warmed dedicated pool reserved for internal jobs: redwood-dedicated-burst-1. Need approvals to route some traffic there.

Lina (Eng-runtime): we can route 15% of traffic for non-SLA customers to that pool. Recommend we also toggle continuous batching off for 60m for all routes to reduce memory pressure. Patch coming.

Ash (SRE): do the changes, please. Also set autoscaler max_retries to 2 to avoid long backoff window, and force immediate reconcile.

Lina (Eng-runtime): patch to autoscaler submitted: 
```yaml
autoscaler:
  max_retries: 2
  reconcile_interval: 15s
  scale_up_delay: 10s
```
Applying now.

Kim (Infra): attached redwood-dedicated-burst-1 and routed low-priority embed traffic there. Creating node pool succeeded (6 nodes) — good. Queue depth dropping from 12,400 -> 5,900 over 7 minutes.

Maya (Support): initial customer impact note: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts for bulk embedding jobs in EU/US-West — mitigation in progress; performance degradation expected for ~30-60 minutes." Pushing to status page.

Ravi (Oncall-ML): observed tail for real-time routes still high (p95 > 3s). Lowering default model concurrency for priority routes to keep latency targets.

Ash (SRE): rolling update to route config: reduce concurrency for gen-tier to 2, batch_size to 8.

Lina (Eng-runtime): also found a bug in the autoscaler where node creation errors were treated as transient and retried with escalating backoff; updated handling to mark resource errors as terminal for the current attempt. Will be in postmortem.

Ash (SRE): monitoring. queue stabilized at ~1.2k and dropping. Throttling still in place for non-critical routes.

Kim (Infra): cloud quota ticket responded: temporary quota raise approved in us-west for +20 nodes, effective immediately. Re-enabled autoscaler scaleups. New capacity attached, queue falling to single digits.

Maya (Support): updated status page: "Mitigation deployed; most customers recovering; bulk embedding throughput degraded — partial reroute to CPU fallback applied. ETA full recovery: 30m."

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 18:55 UTC - Severity: P2. Current state: mitigated. Root cause: rapid demand spike combined with quota limit + autoscaler backoff bug.

Ash (SRE): postmortem/action items:
- ACTION-1: Lina to root-cause autoscaler retry logic and produce detailed writeup (+ PR) - owner: Lina (due 3/20).
- ACTION-2: Kim to request permanent quota increases in key regions and document emergency escalation runbook - owner: Kim (due 3/22).
- ACTION-3: Ravi to add route-level circuit breakers and auto-deprioritization for large batches - owner: Ravi (due 3/21).
- ACTION-4: SRE to add synthetic load tests that model bursty batch traffic and validate autoscaler behavior - owner: Ash (due 3/25).
- ACTION-5: Support to finalize customer comms and send post-incident email to affected accounts - owner: Maya (due 3/19).

Lina (Eng-runtime): I'll file the PR with tests that simulate node create RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and assert autoscaler marks error terminal.

Kim (Infra): will schedule a runbook review and identify available reserved pools for emergency attach.

Ash (SRE): final notes: no data loss. Some customers saw sustained latency increases and timeouts for ~45 minutes. Thanks team for rapid coordination. We'll run a blameless postmortem next Tues 10:00 UTC.

Maya (Support): sending initial incident summary to customer ops now. :white_check_mark:
